status.bridgeOff: The VS Code link is off in ChatonLM
status.incompatible: This extension doesn't match your version of ChatonLM

screen.appClosed: Open ChatonLM to chat with your local models from VS Code.
screen.bridgeOff: Turn on the VS Code link in ChatonLM settings: Settings, VS Code tab, Allow VS Code to connect.
screen.notPaired: In ChatonLM, open Settings, VS Code tab, and choose Pair an editor. Then type the code shown there.
screen.incompatible: Update ChatonLM and this extension to their latest versions.
screen.noModels: No model is installed in ChatonLM yet. Download one there to start.

empty.title: Ask about your code
empty.body: Select code in the editor, then choose an action or ask a question. Nothing is changed in your files.

composer.label: Message to ChatonLM
composer.ephemeral: Ephemeral chat: it won't appear in ChatonLM's history and is erased when you start another chat or close VS Code.
composer.offMachineNewChat: This model runs outside this computer: a new chat was started, so the code of the previous one stays here.

receipt.localDetail: The model runs on this computer: nothing leaves it.
receipt.cloudDetail: The model runs in the cloud: this text is sent over the network.
receipt.remoteDetail: The model runs on another computer (model location set in ChatonLM): this text is sent over the network.
receipt.unknownDetail: ChatonLM couldn't tell where the model runs: this text is handled as if it left this computer.
receipt.bestEffort: Secrets are removed as best as possible, from known patterns: check what you send.

historyDetail.one: Also sent, as it is: {count} earlier message of this chat ({chars}).
historyDetail.other: Also sent, as they are: {count} earlier messages of this chat ({chars}).

receipt.context: About {percent}% of the model's context ({size} tokens).
receipt.secretValue: line that looks like a secret

voice.sharedNothing: Nothing from the editor is shared with the model.

blocked.one: {count} item removed before sending: it may hold secrets.
blocked.other: {count} items removed before sending: they may hold secrets.

where.local: The model runs on this computer: what you say stays on it.
where.cloud: The model runs in the cloud: what you say is sent over the network.
where.remote: The model runs on another computer: what you say is sent over the network.
where.unknown: ChatonLM couldn't tell where the model runs: what you say is handled as if it left this computer.

status.off: Off. When on, a model on this computer suggests code as you type.
status.remoteWindow: Not available in remote windows: the files aren't on this computer.
status.otherProvider: {name} already suggests code in this file, so ChatonLM stays quiet there.
status.notLocal: Autocomplete needs a model on this computer.
status.slow: Too slow: the last suggestions came too late. Measure the speed, or choose a smaller model.

paused.exclusive: Paused: the chat model is using the graphics card.
paused.chatBusy: Paused while a reply is being written.
paused.doesNotFit: Paused: the autocomplete model doesn't fit in this computer's memory.
paused.notInstalled: Paused: the autocomplete model isn't installed in ChatonLM.
paused.notLocal: Autocomplete needs a model on this computer.
paused.notLoaded: Paused: the autocomplete model isn't loaded. Prepare it to start.

gpu.ramNote: No graphics card found: models run in the computer's memory.
gpu.mayNotFit: May not fit on this computer

rating.tooSlow: Too slow here: choose a smaller model

gpu.measureDetail: First word in {ms} ms, {speed} tokens per second.
gpu.measurePartial: Part of the model runs on the processor.
